import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[82]['note']='Rightmost unmasked word is cut at the final glyph; no additional hard sign can be confirmed.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for d in a:f.write(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 keys={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==keys and set(y['confidence'])==keys
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Verified count, order and slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(collections.Counter(v for y in a for v in y['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in a))
